collection_notes: The SOS Book 13 (Multnomah edition) PDF text is cut off by the fetch tool at ~120k characters (page 49), before the judicial and county sections; the county's large-print Multnomah pamphlet (pages 42-43 for Chair) was used instead. The fetch tool limits quotes to ~125 characters, so some excerpts are fragments. Meieran is a former District 1 Commissioner; not on current board roster, so incumbent=false. Pamphlet prints fixmultco.com (redirects to fix-multco.com, which links to SharonforChair.com); filing lists SharonforChair.com. Her pamphlet body text is mainly a critique of county performance; items p1 and p3 reflect that framing. The individual statement PDF (linked from the county's Military & Overseas Online Voters' Guide) supplied the latter part of her statement that the large-print pamphlet fetch cut off.
